project.title: Vertical distributions of airborne microorganisms in Asian dust (Kosa) source region of Taklamakan and Gobi Deserts.
project.description: The vertical distributions of airborne microorganisms are compared between Taklamakan and Gobi Deserts for elucidating the generation mechanisms of airborne microorganisms, which were transported by Asian dust events.
project.center_name: Institute of Science and Engineering, Kanazawa University
